# ScaleForge - Complete Website Digest

> ScaleForge is a premier digital agency building high-performance websites, custom AI automations, and growth-driven SEO & content strategies.

---

## 1. AI Development & Automation Services
URL: https://scalesforge.site/services/ai-development

We build bespoke automation workflows to eliminate repetitive work, generate qualified leads, and publish marketing content 24/7.

### Core Capabilities
* **Lead Generation Automation**: Automatically scrape, enrich, qualify, and deliver high-intent leads directly into your CRM inside Notion or Google Sheets.
* **AI Cold Calling Agents**: Deploy Vapi-powered AI voice agents that call your lead list, handle objections, and book qualified appointments into Calendly.
* **Social Media Autopilot**: From a single brief in Notion, write captions, generate branded visuals, schedule, and auto-publish posts across Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and TikTok.
* **AI Content Generation**: Produce SEO blog posts, email sequences, and ad copy from a single brief using structured AI pipelines built in n8n or Make.com.
* **Workflow & CRM Integration**: Connect Notion, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Slack, and other SaaS tools into one unified automated pipeline.
* **Custom AI Chatbots**: Build bespoke AI assistants trained on your business data to handle customer queries and support tickets.

### Technology Stack
* **n8n**: Complex self-hosted multi-step AI workflow automation.
* **Make.com**: Visual drag-and-drop integration for 1,000+ business applications.
* **Zapier**: Rapid business tool connections.
* **Vapi**: Infrastructure for real-time phone call automation.
* **Notion & Google Sheets**: Dynamic databases serving as content and lead management hubs.

## 2. Web Design Services
URL: https://scalesforge.site/services/web-design

We design custom, conversion-focused websites in Figma from scratch. Absolutely zero pre-made templates.

### Core Offerings
* **Custom UI Design**: Unique layouts, spacing, and hover effects built from scratch to match your specific brand personality.
* **UX & Conversion Architecture**: Logical page hierarchies, smooth content layouts, and strategic CTA placements that reduce scroll fatigue and drive engagement.
* **Mobile-First Responsive Design**: Fluid responsive breakpoints scaled upward to look flawless on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
* **Brand Identity & Style Guides**: Logo refinement, harmonized HSL color scales, typography selections, and comprehensive spacing systems.
* **Landing Page Optimization**: Single-page campaign designs specifically tuned for search advertisements and fast lead acquisition.

### Standards Included
* Comprehensive competitor visual design audit.
* Fully editable Figma source files.
* Spacing guide, color scales, and typography hierarchies.
* WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility-compliant UI layouts.

## 3. Next.js Web Development Services
URL: https://scalesforge.site/services/web-development

We build custom Next.js, React, and TypeScript websites engineered for Core Web Vitals dominance, sub-1.5s load times, and lasting search engine authority.

### Core Capabilities
* **Business Websites**: Highly customized static and dynamic pages with semantic HTML structures and full JSON-LD schemas.
* **E-Commerce Portals**: Supersonic online stores featuring advanced product catalogs, secure payment pipelines, and custom databases.
* **Landing Pages**: Ultra-lightweight single-page apps optimized for maximum loading speeds and Google Ads conversion targets.
* **Web Application Interfaces**: Clean, responsive frontend layouts designed for online SaaS products and dashboard platforms.

### Technology Stack
* **Next.js & React**: The powerful framework powering TikTok, Hulu, and Twitch.
* **Tailwind CSS**: A utility-first stylesheet framework that compiles to tiny, bloat-free CSS classes.
* **Vercel CDN**: Global edge serverless hosting for sub-200ms response times.
* **TypeScript**: Strict type-safe programming that eliminates runtime layout bugs before deployment.
* **Headless CMS**: Sanity CMS integration for visual editing.

## 4. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Services
URL: https://scalesforge.site/services/seo

We optimize site speed, fix sitemap/crawling errors, inject structured schema markup, and build high-authority links to capture consistent organic revenue.

### Strategic Roadmap
* **Months 1–2 (Audit & Base)**: Technical SEO audit, sitemap check, Core Web Vitals optimization, meta updates, and search console setup.
* **Months 3–4 (Content & Spacing)**: High-intent keyword targeting, on-page optimization, content production, and structural landing page checks.
* **Months 5+ (Authority & Scale)**: High-quality link acquisition, programmatic page setups, analytics reporting, and conversion audits.

## 10. Pricing & Packages
URL: https://scalesforge.site/pricing

We provide transparent, upfront monthly pricing tiers for digital services:

### Web Design & Development (Figma + Next.js)
* **Essential** ($1,200/mo): Perfect for small sites (up to 5 pages), basic custom design, clean responsive Next.js build, and standard SEO schema.
* **Growth** ($2,500/mo): Designed for growing teams. Up to 12 pages, custom animations, headless CMS integrations (Sanity), and complete technical audit.
* **Elite** ($4,500/mo): Full-scale custom application interfaces, advanced e-commerce databases, custom portal tools, and 90-day support.

### SEO & Content Strategy
* **Basic Audit** ($800/mo): Full technical crawl audit, error fixes, metadata optimization, and page speed checks.
* **Full-Scale Campaign** ($2,000/mo): Monthly keyword maps, 4 long-form content articles, link acquisition, and monthly conversion reviews.

### AI Automation Sprints
* **Workflow Sprint** ($1,500/mo): Notion + CRM automations, n8n/Make integration setups, and team training.
* **Agent Integration** ($3,500/mo): AI voice agents, appointment booking scripts, and advanced databases.
